messages:
Ravi P.: Heads up — Spectra Systems sent INV-11427. PDF has no PO on the header and the vendor billed the full amount to Redwood, Inc. but the work should be split between AI Labs and Platform. It's in AP with a hold.
Nora T.: I pulled it. Line items show AI model tuning $18,000 and infra consulting $6,000. Vendor email mentions PO 2024-SPEC-05 but they didn’t print it on the invoice.
Elaine (AP): We need either the PO attached or an approval for the non-PO portion. PO 2024-SPEC-05 exists but it's only for AI Labs subscription/licensing, not consulting. Without explicit PO we can’t auto-release any lines. Also AP needs intercompany cross-charge code for the Platform portion.
Ravi P.: Confirming: AI Labs should take the $18k (match to PO 2024-SPEC-05) and Platform should absorb $6k via internal cross-charge GL 6721 -> GL 6820. Who can approve the Platform consulting?
Sam K.: That's me. I can approve the consulting but AP requires a documented approval string or Concur note. I'll add: "Sam K. approves Spectra INV-11427 platform consulting $6,000, GL=6820, cost center=PLAT-OPS, internal charge to AI-LABS." Will paste to the invoice record.
Nora T.: Can you also attach the vendor email that references PO 2024-SPEC-05? AP needs evidence to match subscription to PO. If vendor can reissue with PO on header that would prevent future delays.
Sam K.: Uploaded my approval note to the invoice comments and attached the vendor email screenshot. Also added the requested intercompany code.
finance-bot: Invoice INV-11427 status changed: "held-no-po" -> "manual-review". Assigned approvers: Sam K. (platform), auto-match pending for AI Labs PO 2024-SPEC-05.
Elaine (AP): Thanks. I'll attach PO 2024-SPEC-05 to the invoice record for the AI Labs lines once Nora confirms the PO period covers the invoice date. For the consulting line we have Sam's approval so we can route that in the next AP run after cross-charge mapping is verified. ETA payment for consulting: 2 biz days; subscription portion will release after PO confirm.
Nora T.: PO 2024-SPEC-05 covers May-Dec 2024, invoice date is Oct 2024 so subscription is covered. Attaching PO PDF now. Also emailing vendor ops to ask for PO on future invoice headers and to bill to the correct legal entity (Spectra Systems Ltd -> Redwood Labs entity).
Ravi P.: I'll follow up with vendor to reissue corrected invoice for their accounting. Thanks for the quick turns.
Elaine (AP): Marking consulting line approved and ready. Subscription matched to PO 2024-SPEC-05 and queued for payment once PO attachment is finalized. Closing hold unless AP reopens.
Sam K.: Thanks all. Note: will update vendor contact to include correct GL/cross-charge codes on the next SOW. :white_check_mark:
Nora T.: Closing thread from Product side — will update if vendor responds with a corrected invoice.
